summary: Recorded the duplication and stale-replay probe as a second bounded negative. CheckRun fff65ddf030348c59cf8c3f39e26d380 (exit 0, all three cases) evaluated all six comparisons and every one holds, with the fault fields showing each fault took effect: case B delivered every message addressed to node 2 twice and still ended with all three nodes agreeing on 1,2,3,7,8,9 under node 1, and case C replaced the leader with node 3, replayed 507 retained messages from the old leader after the heal, and still ended with identical decided values everywhere and every node following node 3. I appended the account with conclusion `holds` and no defect judgment, recorded the exercised conditions as knowledge, and closed that question's discriminator while flagging the untested combinations (leader-bound duplication, an old leader kept ignorant until after the replay, and combinations with reordering or crash recovery). The runtime question's discriminator now names the one remaining builder lead inside that layer: `reconcile_unconfirmed`'s one-placeholder-per-index assumption, where a truncation arriving before a tick pops the placeholders for the entries it discards and should shift the index reported to a later caller. No execution was requested this turn (validation reports execution_requested false); with roughly forty minutes left that probe is the next action.
